title: Zeus Juice The Black E-Liquid 10ml
description: The Black is a classic among Zeus’ delicious range of e-liquids and brings punchy ripe berry notes and tart blackcurrants for an irresistibly fruity vape touched with cool menthol on the exhale. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this e-liquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
